result.title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
result.summary: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

AI.brief_summary: 该文是 ECCV 2026 Perception Test 挑战赛的总结报告，围绕空间智能设置四条赛道：原基准的短视频选择题与 grounded videoQA，以及两个基于城市尺度步行视频的新赛道（KilometerAudio、KilometerVision），并汇总各赛道获胜方案。
AI.relevance_reason: 作为多模态推理基准与失败诊断类工作可供核查：报告指出城市尺度时空推理靠昂贵 agentic 流程方能解决、多模态模型单独使用仍困难，这为「动态计算与推理成本」「显式多步流程相对模型内部状态推理的收益」提供对照线索。
